title: Why the next trillion dollar company will be built by one person

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The next trillion-dollar company will be built by one person—because blockchain and smart contracts enable solo execution at scale.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: That's naive. Modern startups require teams for AI training, infrastructure, and user acquisition—no single person can do it all.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Look at Ethereum’s founder. He created a protocol that now powers millions of apps—alone, with open-source collaboration.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Protocols aren’t companies. They’re infrastructure. The real value comes from apps built on top, which need teams to monetize and scale.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: One person can launch a protocol, and others will build on it—just like Bitcoin, created by one, now worth trillions.
